AXE Vocabulary

This file is the canonical list of every name that appears on the wire, in the SDK's public API, in the CLI, and in the derived MCP server. Every other document, every package, and every test refers to these names and nothing else.

This file is the source of truth for code. scripts/gen-vocabulary.mjs parses the tables below and generates packages/core/src/vocabulary.ts, exported as WIRE from @summationai/axe-core/vocabulary. A test regenerates the file and fails if it differs from what is committed. A second test (the drift test in @summationai/axe-testing) scans every Markdown page in spec/, docs/, and the root README.md and fails if an inline code span that looks like a wire name is not in this file, or if a name in this file is never mentioned in the docs or never used in source.

Rules for editing:

  • One row per name. Names are exact, including case.
  • Key is the TypeScript property under WIRE.<category>; it is camelCase and unique within its category.
  • Do not rename a shipped name before 1.0 without a DECISIONS.md entry and a changeset.

pathindex/.well-known/axe-index.jsonHTTPPlatform index of tenant manifests.
pathactions/axe/actionsHTTPPrefix for action invocation. POST /axe/actions/{name} invokes; GET returns the definition.
pathcontinue/axe/continueHTTPPOST to satisfy a needs_input requirement.
pathresume/axe/resumeHTTPPOST after a human handoff completes.
pathpoll/axe/pollHTTPPrefix for the SDK's default pending poll URLs: GET /axe/poll/{token}.
pathstate/axe/stateHTTPGET returns the live state: the current rev and every action's availability. Served with Cache-Control: no-store.

Surface: live-state entries

Names used by @summationai/axe-surface (spec/SURFACE.md): an application's registry of its own live controls, observed and acted on under one revision. Surface results reuse the result envelope, statuses, and error codes above, and the live-state fields (rev, expectedRev, currentRev, available, requires) listed under Fields.

reasonconsentRequiredconsent_requiredneeds_input reasonRecommended reason string when accepts are consent kinds.

reasondocumentRequireddocument_requiredneeds_input reasonRecommended reason string when accepts are document kinds.

reasonjsonRequiredjson_requirederror.details.reason on unsupportedEmitted by the SDK when a POST to a state-changing endpoint is not application/json ([P-TRANS-1]).
reasonpayloadTooLargepayload_too_largeerror.details.reason on invalid_inputEmitted by the SDK, with HTTP 413, when a request body is larger than maxBodyBytes ([P-LIM-1]).

reasonoutcomeUnknownoutcome_unknownerror.details.reason on unavailableThe work was sent and may have taken effect (an act whose page unloaded before it answered); retryable is false and the result is stored under the idempotency key ([P-OP-3]).

JSON Schema keywords

The JSON Schema keywords the protocol's supported subset names ([P-SCHEMA-1] to [P-SCHEMA-4], docs/schemas.md). They are JSON Schema's own names, listed so the drift test knows them; the subset, and what happens outside it, is in the spec.

CategoryKeyNameWhereMeaning

schemapatternPropertiespatternPropertiesJSON Schema, in subsetMembers whose names match a pattern.
schemapropertyNamespropertyNamesJSON Schema, in subsetA schema every member name must match.
schemaminPropertiesminPropertiesJSON Schema, in subsetFewest members.
schemamaxPropertiesmaxPropertiesJSON Schema, in subsetMost members.
schemadependentRequireddependentRequiredJSON Schema, in subsetMembers required when another is present.
schemadependentSchemasdependentSchemasJSON Schema, in subsetA schema applied when a member is present.
schemaprefixItemsprefixItemsJSON Schema, in subsetSchemas for the first array items, in order (tuples).
schemaminItemsminItemsJSON Schema, in subsetFewest array items.
schemamaxItemsmaxItemsJSON Schema, in subsetMost array items.
schemauniqueItemsuniqueItemsJSON Schema, in subsetNo two array items deeply equal.
schemaminContainsminContainsJSON Schema, in subsetFewest items matching contains.
schemamaxContainsmaxContainsJSON Schema, in subsetMost items matching contains.
schemaminLengthminLengthJSON Schema, in subsetShortest string, in code points.
schemaexclusiveMinimumexclusiveMinimumJSON Schema, in subsetNumber strictly above.
schemaexclusiveMaximumexclusiveMaximumJSON Schema, in subsetNumber strictly below.
schemamultipleOfmultipleOfJSON Schema, in subsetNumber an exact decimal multiple of ([P-SCHEMA-3]).
schemaallOfallOfJSON Schema, in subsetEvery schema must match.
schemaanyOfanyOfJSON Schema, in subsetAt least one schema must match.
schemaoneOfoneOfJSON Schema, in subsetExactly one schema must match.
schemawriteOnlywriteOnlyJSON Schema annotationIgnored by the validator.
schemaunevaluatedPropertiesunevaluatedPropertiesJSON Schema, not in subsetRefuses every value in the SDK's validator ([P-SCHEMA-2]).
schemaunevaluatedItemsunevaluatedItemsJSON Schema, not in subsetRefuses every value in the SDK's validator ([P-SCHEMA-2]).
schemaadditionalItemsadditionalItemsJSON Schema, not in subsetDraft 7; refuses every value in the SDK's validator ([P-SCHEMA-2]).
